_what: Print placement measured on Tapstitch's own flat lays, as ratios of the garment's chest width (armpit to armpit). d = (ink top - collar) / chest, w = ink width / chest, cx = (ink centre x - collar x) / chest. Applied to each on-model photo by composite_front_v2.py.
_collar: tee and crew: top edge of the front neck rib at centre; hoodie: the point of the V where the hood's two sides cross at centre front; bomber front: the V where the collar ribs meet the zip; bomber back: bottom of the collar band at centre
